---
title: "Courtney"
format: html
---
```{r}
#pulling datasets in
dataset <- load("data/wrangledData.Rdata")

#packages
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#| label: Coach Salary
ggplot(coach_box_plot, aes(x=Gender, y=Salary, fill=Gender)) + 
    geom_boxplot(alpha=0.3) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Men_Salary" = "Men", 
                              "Women_Salary" = "Women")) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Coach Salary", y = "Salary (dollars)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "pink"),
            labels = c("Men_Salary" = "Men",
             "Women_Salary" = "Women")) +
    theme_minimal()

```
